The Kfar Hanokdim Quiz

B Jerusalem
C Rome
2. Which colors are on the flag of Israel?
A blue and orange
B blue and red
C blue and white
3. What money do people use in Israel?
A the shekel
B the Australian dollar
C the Canadian dollar
